title: Mixed Event — Nocturne Interlude — Episode7 Nighttime Cantabile

meta.Event Outline: Toya has decided to create street music as a member of Vivid BAD SQUAD. But something happens to make him wonder if classical music still has some hold on him, leading to some self-doubt...

rows.Line: Live House

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Doors are opening soon.
Everyone ready?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You know it! My voice is in top condition today too, so we're gonna crush this!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yeah! Let's get out there and win!
Oh...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Sounds like they just opened up...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Ah...! There's my dad!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Really? Where?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Um, the man wearing glasses...
Holding the large camera...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, him? Hehe.
Now I know where you get your vibes from!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Y-Yes, but... Gasp!
The staff just went up to talk to him!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, right... Filming's prohibited at this event.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: After I told him not to bring his camera too...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What about you, Toya? How'd things go with your dad...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Well...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I invited him to come today.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: You invited him?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So, is he coming?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I don't know.
All I did was give him the ticket.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But it doesn't matter whether he comes or not.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: The only thing I can do now is sing.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: That's true...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Then let's just do what we always do!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Right.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Looks like we can count on him today, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Count on me...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: We were talking the other day about how much easier things are when you're out there singing with us.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yup. And I think it's because your singing is like the backbone that supports the team.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So we'll be counting on you today!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I see.
Just leave it to me then...

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line: Our next group is Vivid BAD SQUAD!

rows.Speaker: Spectator A
rows.Line: Nice! They're the favorites for this one!

rows.Speaker: Spectator B
rows.Line: Eh, I doubt it. They fell apart during STAY GOLDEN the other time.

rows.Speaker: Spectator B
rows.Line: They're great singers individually, but it's like there's nobody holding them together, you know?

rows.Speaker: Bespectacled Man
rows.Line:
K-Kohane! You can do this!
Show them what you're made of!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: D-Dad... Stop embarrassing me...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (My dad... He isn't here, unsurprisingly.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (But that's not a problem.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Let's do this, Toya.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yeah.
song00005_off_f

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I don't understand... It's like I can hear everyone's voices much clearer than usual.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I know what's coming and how to adjust my voice to match theirs by just feeling instead of thinking.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Which means all that's left for me to do now is...)

rows.Speaker: Spectator A
rows.Line:
Hey! How's this for falling apart?!
They're off the hook!

rows.Speaker: Spectator B
rows.Line:
W-What is this...?!
They're completely different from before...!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (All that's left for me to do now is to sing my heart out...!)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: *Huff*... *Huff*...

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line:
That's the loudest the crowd's been all night!
Give it up for Vivid BAD SQUAD!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, Toya...!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Huh? Whoa...!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Where've you been hiding that voice all this time, dude?!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
No, it just happened by chance...
I had no idea I could sing like that either.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It wasn't by chance.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It's because you got over whatever was going on between you and your dad.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Great job, Toya.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
You must be right.
Thanks, Akito.
